topic: FIRST confirmed live-human voice amplification (not a phone playback)
significance: every earlier 'amplification' result used the phone recording standing in for the human voice. This is the first time a person speaking into the microphone was heard as amplified by that same person.

setup.source: live human speech, no recording, phone paused
setup.speaker: 100 cm from the microphone, side-facing, cotton over the plate

earlier_run_at_5cm.status: INVALID as a measurement because the input clipped; the listening report is kept only as an informal observation, not as evidence

input_gate.note: the 5 cm precheck passed but the actual speech was louder than the precheck, which is why the run clipped; at 12 cm there was ample margin

what_this_establishes: a person speaking into this microphone at about 12 cm can hear their own voice amplified at -8 dB with zero coefficients, without howling
the amplification is not an artefact of the phone playback
what_this_does_not_establish: clarity was 'fairly clear', not 'clear'; no claim of high-quality amplification
no comparison against the candidate model on live speech
no sustained-use test on live speech
no measurement of how much louder it actually was
